tools.name: find_candidates
tools.description: Search the DevMatch index for engineers matching a job description. Pass JD text — formal description, informal request, role brief, paste of a README, or anything in between. The longer + more specific, the better the match. Returns ranked candidates with FULL profile data inline per result: handle, name, bio, location, followers, top_repos, top_topics, matched_projects (with contribution counts), contact info (email + social URLs when available), and candidate_score. You do NOT need to call ge

params.name: input
params.description: Job description text (preferred), OR a PUBLIC github.com repo URL. For private repos, paste the README content as text instead of the URL. The richer the input, the better the ranking.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Fetch one contributor's profile card when the user mentions a specific GitHub handle that was NOT already returned by find_candidates. Use cases: (a) user types 'tell me about @karpathy'; (b) user references a handle they found elsewhere; (c) user wants to verify someone before outreach. Do NOT call this immediately after find_candidates for handles in those results — find_candidates already returns full profile data inline per candidate (bio, location, contact, top_repos, top_topics). IMPORTANT

params.name: handle
params.description: The GitHub handle to look up. Plain login name, no '@' prefix (e.g. 'karpathy', not '@karpathy').

tools.name: find_similar_projects
tools.description: Find open-source projects similar to a given GitHub repo, ranked by semantic similarity to its description/topics/README. Each result includes the project's top contributors so the caller can pivot from a project to its maintainers in one step. Use for landscape mapping ("what else is like X?"), competitive intel, or to expand a candidate search past a single anchor project.

params.name: repo
params.description: Seed repo in `owner/name` form (e.g. 'karpathy/llm.c'). A full github.com URL is also accepted; the server strips the prefix.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of similar projects to return. Defaults to 10, max 25.
